_comment: Checked-in expected-failure list for the unified 03:00 batch runner (T-20261112-002; ADR-0105 Decision 8; design docs/designs/2026-11-12-unified-batch-runner-design.md R12/AC-6). A gate failure matching an entry id is a SANCTIONED repair: the runner logs it to the run manifest (sanctionedRepairs[]) and continues; the repaired files still pass the secrets gate; it is never escalated as an unexpected gate failure. A gate failure matching NO entry is unexpected: the second one trips the watchdog stop-file (.pipeline-state/automation-stop). The list is versioned in git and grows only through the PR path; entries carry the source that sanctioned them.
note: Decision of record: docs/adr/0105-unified-batch-runner.md (Decision 8, mechanics bound by artifacts). Consumers: the unified runner's gate-failure classification and the run-manifest sanctioned-repair log.

entries.sanctionedRecovery: restore block + forward commit per gate instruction
